AI recruiting agent narrowing 20M profiles to ~10 qualified applicants per job posting via embeddings retrieval and fine-tuned LLM.

## Challenge

Speed up recruiter candidate review load on xing.com. Recruiters had to manually sift through a large candidate pool, making the review process slow and inconsistent.

## Solution

Built a multi-stage recruiting agent: embeddings-based retrieval narrows 20M profiles to 1,000 candidates, a fine-tuned LLM prescreens those to ~200, and personalised outreach selects ~10 qualified and interested applicants per job posting — delivered directly to the recruiter.

Analysis-ready cloud-optimised ERA5 reanalysis on Earthmover Arraylake with ACID transactions and attached SLA.

## Challenge

Provide access to the most recent ERA5 reanalysis data for AIFS model training as well as historical analysis for paying B2B customers — with data freshness guarantees and reliable access SLAs.

## Solution

Built an analysis-ready cloud-optimised (ARCO) ERA5 dataset on Earthmover Arraylake leveraging Icechunk for ACID transactions. The dataset supports concurrent reads for large-scale ML training workloads and point-in-time historical queries for downstream B2B analytics, with an attached SLA covering data freshness and availability.

Kaggle-style sub-seasonal to seasonal climate forecast challenge with curated datasets and a reproducible verification pipeline.

## Challenge

Run a rigorous Kaggle-style challenge for sub-seasonal to seasonal (S2S) climate forecasts that lowers the barrier to entry for ML-based submissions while maintaining scientific reproducibility.

## Solution

Curated training datasets and a verification pipeline on git and notebook-based Renkulab. The setup enabled clean, standardised ML forecast submissions with minimal infrastructure overhead, supporting both functional and skill-based forecast verification.

ML-driven ad targeting on xing.com — from logistic regression baseline to deep neural network personalisation at scale.

## Challenge

Determine which ad to show which user on xing.com to maximise relevance and click-through rates across millions of daily impressions.

## Solution

Built a logistic regression baseline for audience targeting, then extended it to a deep neural network for personalised ad delivery at scale — improving relevance signals and enabling fine-grained user-level personalisation across the XING Marketing Solutions platform.
